title: StickCraft
description: Custom sticks that give you abilities
body:
# StickCraft
Turn ordinary sticks into ability-based items with unique effects.

StickCraft is a Paper 1.21+ plugin that adds seven craftable sticks, each with its own right-click ability and cooldown.

---

## Features
- Seven custom sticks, each with a unique ability  
- Fully customizable crafting recipes  
- Lightweight and built specifically for Paper  
- Give command for sticks

---

## Sticks and Abilities

| Stick        | Ability           | Description                                      | Cooldown |
|--------------|------------------|--------------------------------------------------|----------|
| Bone Stick   | Withering Lunge  | Launch forward and applies wither to nearby enemies   | 10s      |
| Blaze Stick  | Flame Burst      | Ignites enemies in a single line in front of you                  | 8s       |
| Frost Stick  | Frost Nova       | Slows nearby enemies                  | 12s      |
| Thunder Stick| Lightning Strike | Call lightning where you are looking                   | 15s      |
| Ender Stick  | Void Step        | Teleport to where you are looking               | 10s      |
| Venom Stick  | Poison Cloud     | Releases a poison cloud around you (You are not immune!)              | 10s      |
| Iron Stick   | Iron Skin        | Gain resistance and extra health briefly         | 20s      |


---

## Notices
- Cooldowns cannot be custom configured

---

## Compatibility
- Paper 1.21+  
- Not tested on Spigot or Bukkit
